shots.direction: Facing mostly toward the viewer. cocky smug grin, one eye closed as if aiming, making a finger-gun with her right hand pointed straight at the viewer.
Facing mostly toward the viewer. victorious fierce grin with teeth, shouting in triumph, one fist pumped up beside her face.
Facing mostly toward the viewer. fierce battle shout with mouth open, eyebrows angled with resolve, pointing her index finger straight at the viewer, twin tails whipped back by a gust.
Facing mostly toward the viewer. frustrated and cornered: gritting her teeth, glaring hard with a bead of sweat on her cheek, fist clenched tight near her chest.
